messages.text: What firmware does the nexus S1 use

The N. S1 runs its own stock firmware from Nexus, not Harlo OS — it's a standalone 10 TH/s unit you configure through its web dashboard, pool URL and worker included.

Anything specific you're trying to do with it — solo, or point it at a pool?

I don't know HashWatcher well enough to tell you yes or no, and I won't guess on compatibility.

I've passed it to the team — JD answers the hardware side. They pick it up today at 10am ET and the answer comes to your email.
Are the dimensions the same as a nerdqaxe
Read the nexus s1 10th s page

The S1 listing doesn't publish dimensions — only the shipped weight, 2.72 kg (6 lb). So I can't tell you it matches a NerdQaxe, and I won't guess.

It's with JD alongside the HashWatcher question; both come back to you by email after 10am ET today.

Anything about the S1 I can answer from the listing — power, noise, what's in the box?
Does it come with a rear fan?

Yes — it ships with cooling built in: an AXP90 full-copper heatsink with a heat pipe and a fan, about 50 dB. The listing doesn't say where the fan sits, so I won't call it "rear" specifically, but there's no extra fan to buy.

Where are you thinking of putting it?
